description: White Punisher skull logo (the Marvel Comics character’s emblem, with elongated vertical teeth) centered on a solid black background, in tall phone-wallpaper proportions. The symbol is frequently used in Q posts and follower imagery as a ‘Punisher’ motif signalling punishment of alleged wrongdoers.

Black-and-white photograph of Donald Trump pointing a finger at Barack Obama while speaking closely to him amid a formal crowd, consistent with the January 20 2017 inauguration; a man resembling Eric Trump stands in the left foreground. An overlaid caption attributes to Trump the quote “When I’m done it’ll be like you were never even here,” a claim of the meme, not a verified statement.
text: “WHEN I’M DONE IT’LL BE LIKE YOU WERE NEVER EVEN HERE”
flags: Overlaid quote is unsourced/unverified as an actual Trump statement
Eric Trump identification from resemblance, not certain

description: Mobile screenshot of a verified tweet by Kenyan President Uhuru Kenyatta (@UKenyatta) describing his meeting with opposition leader Raila Odinga at Harambee House — their March 2018 ‘handshake’ reconciliation. The attached photo shows Kenyatta and Odinga shaking hands in a wood-panelled room with Kenyan flags. Phrases including ‘Uhuru Kenyatta’ and ‘this country of Kenya is greater than any one individual’ are highlighted in yellow by whoever captured the screenshot.

description: Screenshot of three paragraphs from a news article quoting President Trump’s New York Times interview remark, “Whatever happened to this Pakistani guy who worked with the DNC?” — a reference to former House IT aide Imran Awan. The article notes an August grand-jury indictment in the U.S. District Court for the District of Columbia charging Awan and his wife Hina Alvi with four counts including federal bank fraud and conspiracy, to which Awan pleaded not guilty, and quotes Trump asking about ‘the two servers that they broke up into a million pieces.’ Pink underlines highlight the ‘Pakistani guy’/DNC phrases and ‘Whatever happened to them?’.
text: “Whatever happened to this Pakistani guy who worked with the DNC?” the president asked in an interview published Thursday by the New York Times. A grand jury in August returned an indictment in the U.S. District Court for the District of Columbia charging Awan and his wife, Hina Alvi, with a total of four counts, which included federal bank fraud and conspiracy. Awan has pleaded not guilty to all charges. “Whatever happened to them?” Trump continued. “With the two servers that they broke up into a million pieces? Whatever happened to him?”
orgs: U.S. District Court for the District of Columbia
flags: Trump’s quoted remarks about the DNC servers are his claims as reported, not established fact
Source outlet of the article is not visible in the crop
